messages:
anya: Heads up — want to schedule an after-action review for the API timeout spike last night. Thinking 60m to cover timeline, root cause, action items. Who should we invite? @mike @liz

mike: I can do a short slot. Options: Wed 10:00am PT / Thu 4:00pm CET / Fri 9:00am PT. Prefer Wed. :calendar:

liz: Invite SRE + QA + Product. Please add @shaun (oncall), @dave (QA), and @olivia (product). Also would like the runbook gaps on the agenda.

shaun: I can make Wed 10 PT. I'll bring the oncall timeline and the pager logs. We should include an item for metrics/alert thresholds (we missed the CPU spike signal).

dave: Wed works for me. Can we make it 75m? There's a fair bit to cover and I'd like time for action assignment.

anya: Draft agenda below — open to edits. If no objections I'll book Wed 10 PT for 60m and we can extend to 75 if needed. Please drop any artifacts in this thread before EOD.

```
Draft agenda (60m):
- 10m: Incident timeline (who/when/impact)
- 15m: Monitoring & root cause analysis
- 15m: Short-term mitigations / rollback reasoning
- 15m: Long-term fixes, owners, and timelines
- 5m: Follow-ups & action confirmations
```

olivia: Can we add a quick 'customer impact & comms' bullet under timeline? I'll prep a one-slide summary. Also suggest inviting the release manager to confirm deployment rollbacks.

mike: +1 on the extra 15m if we need it. If folks prefer 75m I can update the invite.

anya: OK — updated plan: book 75m to be safe. I'll include attendees: @mike, @liz, @shaun, @dave, @olivia, release-manager. Meeting invite incoming.

dave: I'll upload the failing test logs and the post-deploy metrics here: https://redwood.internal/incident/INC-4321/logs (link)

shaun: Adding observability checklist to pre-read: missing dashboards and alert runbook entries. Will paste short snippet here later.

deploy-bot: [automated] Created calendar event: After-action review — API timeout spike — Wed 10:00am PT (75m). Organizer: anya.

anya: Thanks all. Action items before meeting: 1) Drop any logs/graphs in this thread (everyone) 2) @shaun to paste observability checklist 3) @olivia to prepare customer impact slide 4) @mike to add deployment diff. We'll run through owners and deadlines live. If anything urgent, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
